text: {"memo": "Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) delivered a solid FY2024, posting revenue of $306\u202fbillion, up 12% from FY2023, while net income rose 9% to $93\u202fbillion, yielding an EPS of $135. Operating cash flow reached $118\u202fbillion, supporting a free cash flow margin of roughly 38%. Gross margin held steady at about 45%, and operating margin improved to 28%, reflecting disciplined cost management and strong advertising demand recovery. In FY2023, Alphabet had generated $273\u202fbillion in revenue, $85\u202fbillion in net income, and $108\u202fbillion in operating cash flow, with comparable margins. The prior year, FY2022, saw revenue of $282\u202fbillion, net income of $73\u202fbillion, and operating cash flow of $95\u202fbillion, indicating a gradual slowdown in top\u2011line growth as market saturation and regulatory pressures began to bite. Despite the deceleration, Alphabet\u2019s dominant position in search, cloud, and emerging AI services kept profitability robust, with net margins hovering around 30% in FY2024. The stock trades at a premium multiple reflecting continued growth potential, but investors should monitor margin sustainability as competition intensifies. Overall, Alphabet remains a high\u2011quality growth play, though valuation now reflects mature\u2011stage expectations."}
